answer_1.quote: We propose CoachMe, a reference-based motion-to-instruction model that generates tailored instructions for sports.

answer_2.quote: We utilized several standard metrics: BLEU, ROUGE, and BertScore.

answer_3.quote: Claude (via its API) is employed as the evaluation LLM in our implementation of the G-Eval methodology.

answer_4.quote: We work with figure skating coaches and provide professional evaluations. Table 5 demonstrates the results of human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators rated instructions as Good, Neutral, or Bad and assessed the presence and correctness of sport indicators.
